main: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background PNG for an ORIGINAL 2D side-scrolling sci-fi shooter REBOUND, no existing franchise imagery. Panoramic 16:9 composition, output about 1536x864 and maximum dimension 2048. No player, no enemies, no projectiles, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Entire background is opaque.
